## Change / 修改内容

Describe the change and its purpose. / 简述修改及原因。

## Evidence / 依据

For data changes, link the event source and explain its date, version, and significance.
数据变更请附来源，说明事件日期、具体版本和收录理由。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Updated text is available in Chinese and English. / 新文案包含中英文。
- [ ] UI changes checked on desktop and mobile. / 界面改动已检查桌面与移动端。
